$comment: The camera's on-glass palette: the one source for firmware/p4/main/ui_palette.h. Edit here, then run npm run palette:gen. npm run palette:check fails when the header is stale. Values are sRGB hex; the panel shows them as RGB565, so the low 3 bits of red and blue and the low 2 of green are dropped. The base is MAO's (mao_ui_type.h: ground 08080A, ink F1ECE2); the one colour is MAO pink F3A2C4, shifted slightly toward lavender on each launch (K_LAUNCH). Greys are neutral in their RGB565 code: G6 = 2 R5 = 2 B5.

K_GROUND.note: The ground: every screen's face, the shoot and photograph views, the boot field, sleep.

K_SCRIM.note: Black: the scrim over a screen and the panel going dark.

K_SURFACE.note: A window or list ground, a status panel, the toast plate, the pane behind a photograph. 1.05:1 on the ground, so it is found by its edge or its content.

K_ROW.note: A row you can press, and a disabled one: one flat tone for every row of every list. K_INK on it is 15.5:1.

K_RULE.note: The hairline between two facts, under a header, round a four-mark cell, and the track under a bar.

K_OFF.note: A toggle that is off, a neutral press, Cancel, an empty four-mark cell, a tile still loading. Only K_INK goes on it (11.5:1).

K_EDGE.note: The edge of a thing you can press: 5.1:1 on the ground, 4.6:1 on a row, 3.4:1 on K_OFF (WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1).

K_INK.note: The light ink: every word on the dark grounds, the marks, the star, SENT, a selected segment's fill.

K_INK_QUIET.note: The quiet ink: 5.7:1 on the ground, 5.4:1 on a window, 5.1:1 on a row. Never on K_OFF (3.8:1).

K_ACCENT_INK.note: The dark ink set on the launch shade: the SHOOT card, a pressed control. 9:1 or more on every shade, 5.6:1 or more pressed.

K_FAULT.note: Red as a mark or a fill: a lost camera, a destructive press, the lens hint. Ink on it is K_GROUND (5.1:1), never K_INK (3.4:1).

K_FAULT_INK.note: Red as type on the dark grounds: 6.8:1 on the ground, 6.0:1 on a row.

K_LIVE.note: Retired in this pass: mint. Still drawn by the four-mark, SENT and the ROLL lamp until each moves to K_INK.

K_FACE.note: The face of the menu and every detail screen: the ground, as on MAO.

K_SHADOW.note: Retired in this pass: the offline ROLL lamp.

K_HAIRLINE.note: Retired in this pass: an empty four-mark cell's keyline, a track under a bar.

K_ON.note: A selection that stays: the live segment, a toggle that is on, a favourite that is set. Ink, not colour; colour is for a press.

K_ON_INK.note: The label or knob on K_ON: 17.4:1.

K_TITLE.note: A screen's or a dialog's title. Monochrome at rest.

K_MARK.note: The wordmark at sleep and at power-down. Marks are ink, never colour.

K_TOAST.note: The toast's plate, with a K_EDGE outline and K_INK words. A remark is not an event and carries no colour.

K_LAUNCH.note: The launch shade: MAO pink F3A2C4 and seven steps toward lavender C7A6F7, at most 40 % of the hue gap (OKLCH, L and C of F3A2C4 kept, 20 degrees in all). ui.c takes row boot_count % 8 once at start (ui_set_launch_index). Each is a distinct RGB565 code; K_ACCENT_INK on each is 9.0:1 or more, each on the ground 9.9:1 or more.

K_LAUNCH_DOWN.note: The launch shade, pressed: the same hue at 84 % of its OKLCH lightness. K_ACCENT_INK on each is 5.6:1 or more.

K_BF_WARM.note: The boot field's four inks per launch shade, in the order the field picks them: the ink, the shade, the shade half way to the ink, and the shade 55 % of the way to the ground (ui.c mix() on the RGB565 codes). Row i goes with K_LAUNCH[i].

K_BF_COLD.note: Cold: the instrument before it knows what it is shooting. The field comes up in these and travels to the launch shade's inks as the cameras answer. Code-neutral greys, light to dark.
